statement: Cloud AI infrastructure spending for next year has been revised up to $1.3 trillion, a 60% year-over-year increase.
why: An upward revision of this size in cloud AI budgets is the single largest driver of accelerator and memory order volume next year.

impact.mechanism: Higher cloud capex budgets convert directly into accelerator, memory, power and data-center orders.

evidence.excerpt: Cloud companies' AI infrastructure spending has been revised to $1.3 trillion for next year, a 60% increase year-over-year.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet citing an unnamed forecast; no issuer filing or vendor guidance behind the figure.
